name: RCNS
group: Western University and Robarts Research Institute (Drangova)
versions: 2009 TBME (Thakur, fluoroscopy); 2013 TBME (Tavallaei, MR-compatible, ultrasonic motors); 2016 IJCARS (3 DOF, plunger added)
target_anatomy: cardiac / EP catheterisation; carotid model; ablation lesions (porcine, thesis)
devices_driven: 6-7 F ablation catheters (input catheter as leader, patient catheter as follower)
translation_detail: friction-roller (urethane drive wheel(s) with spring-loaded idler rollers; two chained active rollers from 2013)
rotation_detail: catheter in a slip-ring gantry rotated by a servo (2013: ultrasonic motors); chain drive
device_range: adjustable platform for different catheter gauges; 6-7 F used
haptics_leader: none; leader is a real input catheter read by optical encoders
imaging_compat: fluoroscopy (2009); MRI-compatible (2013): worst-case SNR drop 2.5%, slave 60 cm from isocentre; 2016 SNR drop < 3%, no artifacts
validation_detail: 2009: bench plus 8 operators navigating a carotid model; 2013: bench and in-scanner tests; porcine in-vivo and ex-vivo tests reported in the Western thesis (ir.lib.uwo.ca/etd/3024), web summary only, animal count not read
key_numbers: 2009: within 1 mm and 1 deg, latency under 300 ms; 2013: delay 41+-21 ms, 2+-2 deg radial, 1.0+-0.8 mm over 100 mm axial; 2016: axial error < 1 mm over 30 mm; axial grip 4 N, radial grip 18 mN.m
